summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Huize Holding Ltd, a foreign private issuer, reporting select operating metrics for Q1 2026. The filing includes first-year premiums, renewal premiums, gross written premiums, new customers acquired, accumulated customers, and persistency ratios. It is a standard periodic update of business metrics, not a special situation event. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or corporate action is announced. The filing is purely operational and financial reporting, with no change in control, capital structure, or corporate governance. The appropriate US-equivalent is a press release of quarterly operating results.
